g.text: P1-406 METAL DETECTOR CONVEYOR: DRAWING SET
Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-406 Metal detector conveyor (built frame, used head) · rev B
304 frame, FRP + UHMW through the head
No product contact (pack closed): #4 brushed or bead blast; passivate ASTM A967
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: Metal detector conveyor P1-406 (CCP-1), built in house around a used search head, 1 off, rev B
Closed, labelled packs pass a refurbished head on a 6 in belt; the frame keeps all metal out of the metal-free zone; detects go into a locked bin
check every pack (66 Ø shakers, 86.4 Ø jars) after the labeler P1-404, 14 packs / min
P1-418 used, aperture 300 x 250, test pieces Fe 1.5 / NFe 2.0 / SS 2.5; own supply
PU 2 mm FDA 6 in, 16 m/min, Ø60 pulleys, UHMW bed on FRP rails through the head; spliced in place
2 bolted 304 end frames outside |x| 475, low spine and head stand with G10 insulator; belt top z 905
stop and push: 24 V actuator 150 stroke into a locked bin, bin-entry eye confirms
CLICK PLC, START / STOP / E-stop / QA reset key, 3-colour stack light + buzzer, fail-safe head relays
120 V 1-ph cord and plug, 3.5 A; head on its own receptacle
full shop set: bolted end frames, FRP / UHMW metal-free zone, splice-in-place belt, electric reject with bin-entry confirm
P1-406 METAL DETECTOR CONVEYOR: DRAWING SET
FRAME: END FRAMES, SPINE, HEAD STAND
BELT RUN: PULLEYS, TAKE-UP, FRP RAILS, BED, GUIDES
REJECT: PUSHER, PADDLE, LOCKED BIN, EYE BRACKETS
1. Units mm [in]. Third-angle projection. Tolerances in the title block unless noted. Welding to AWS D1.6.
2. No product contact: packs are closed and labelled. Finish #4 or bead blast, passivated ASTM A967.
3. Cut files (DXF) in dxf/ in mm and inch; 3D: cad/ (STEP per part, P1-406-ASM.step/.glb); generator: design.py, model.py, sh_*.py.
4. The used head must be in hand (or its drawing confirmed) before the head stand 104 and the side-plate MFZ ends are cut: aperture, housing length, lug positions.
5. Release for build: drawings checked, ITP P1-406-900 attached to the traveler, materials certified, program P1-406-FW-01 loaded, head validated (T9, T15-T18).
